karten.vorne: So kannst du über technologische Entwicklungen sprechen
karten.hinten: Technology has become an integral part of our lives, revolutionizing the way we live, work and interact with the world and with each other. · Augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR) are redefining our perception of the world. From gaming and entertainment to education and healthcare, AR and VR are creating new possibilities. · Unlike humans, AI can process vast amounts of data at incredible speed. This ability allows AI systems to quickly identify patterns, make predictions and provide insights. · The rise of robotics is transforming industries by enhancing efficiency and minimizing human intervention in dangerous environments. · In the fields of biotechnology and genetic engineering, scientists are unlocking secrets of our DNA, leading to breakthroughs in personalized medicine, disease prevention, and agriculture. · 3D printing has evolved beyond a novelty to a transformative technology. Three-dimensional objects can be created layer by layer, with applications ranging from manufacturing and healthcare to construction and aerospace. · The development of autonomous vehicles will most likely revolutionize transportation.

Supporters of personalized advertising argue that it improves user experience. · It is also often said that you can even save money through discounts. · Another argument in favour of personalized advertising is the idea that customers feel more appreciated when they see an advertisement that seems specifically targeted towards them. · Receiving discounts on products you would have bought anyway is undeniably a benefit. · Most companies maintain that they offer clear insight into which data is collected and how it is used.

karten.vorne: So kannst du Argumente abwägen und gegenüberstellen
karten.hinten: By contrast, opponents of personalized advertising claim that you might miss out on other products because you are only exposed to companies that fit your preferences. · Still, some people disagree with this because, from their perspective, seeing ads everywhere that are based on their browser history can be scary. · However, those privacy controls might not always be as beneficial as they seem. · While companies argue that users have full control over their data, many customers fear their personal data gets leaked. · On the one hand, personalized advertising definitely has its advantages, but on the other hand, it also comes with risks that should not be ignored.

For instance, this also means you save time by avoiding extensive research for a specific product. · For example, by receiving offers via email for products left in your online cart. · In other words, those recommendations might not be as convenient as they seem to begin with. · From a psychological perspective, this is supposed to create a sense of connection, an emotional bond, mainly because it gives the impression the company is putting in an effort to understand their customers. · Giving away so much of your data in exchange for a small advantage, such as a 5% discount, seems questionable to many. · To give an example, privacy controls are often hidden in the settings and difficult to find. · That is to say, no matter what your privacy settings, there is always a risk that unauthorized individuals or companies could gain access to your data.
